TOBACCO MARKETING CONTROL RULES, 1985
TOBACCO MARKETING CONTROL RULES, 1985
[Gazett of N.‑W. F. P., Extraordinary, 4th May,
1985]
No. S.O.A.‑II (AD) 4 (121/84 Vol. IV.‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 4 of Martial Law Order No. 487
promulgated by the Martial Law Administrator Zone `B' on 16th April, 1985 and
in supersession of this Department's Notification No. SOA‑II (AD) 4
(12)/84 Vol. IV, dated the 12th July, 1984, the Government of the North‑West
Frontier Province is pleased to make the following rules, namely :‑
1. (i) These rules may be called the Tobacco Marketing
Control Rules, 1985.
(ii) They shall come into force at once.
2. In these rules unless there is anything repugnant to
the subject or context.
(a) "Board" means the Pakistan Tobacco Board
established under the Pakistan Tobacco Board Ordinance, 1968 (Ordinance I of
1968) ;
(b) "growers" means the person engaged in
production of tobacco ;
(c) "purchase depot" means the premises
established by the Tobacco Companies at different places in tobacco growing
areas for the purchase of tobacco used in cigarette manufacture ;
(d) Tobacco Company" includes the firm or agency
involved in the purchase, re-drying and processing of tobacco used in the
manufacture of cigarettes and its marketing ;
(e) "Tobacco Dealers, Mandiwalas, Agents and
Suppliers" mean the traders who are involved in the purchase and sale of
virginia and white Patta (Mulki Tobacco) for manufacture of cigarettes or for
consumption by other modes such as Chillum, Hookah, gazari, snuff and bidis.
3. Intimation regarding purchase targets.‑The Board
shall publicise the requirements of Tobacco Companies for various types of
tobaccos, in appropriate manner, before the commencement of planting season.
4. Agreements.‑The Tobacco Companies shall enter
into agreements with the growers on the form prescribed by Board and the
execution of such agreements shall be completed by December 31, each year for
the ensuing crop.
5. Scrutiny of Agreements.‑The Board shall
constitute Committees of growers for scrutiny of the agreements executed by
each Tobacco Company in order to verify its genuineness.
6. Commencement of purchase season.‑The Board shall
constitute Committee comprising of its own official representative of
Provincial Agriculture Department, Tobacco Companies and tobacco growers to fix
a date or dates for the commencement of purchase season after surveying the
condition of standing crop in different areas.
7. Closure of purchase season.‑No Tobacco Company
shall close its purchase depots till such time it has purchased its full
targetted demand of various types of tobacco, or in case of a surplus
production, the additional quantity of particular type of tobacco which may be
allocated by the Board to the individual Tobacco Companies proportionate to
their purchase targets.
8. Labour charges not to be claimed.‑No Tobacco
Company shall claim labour charges from the tobacco growers which are brought
in 'fulfilment of the contractual obligations and as per programme indicted by
the Tobacco Companies.
9. Returns.‑All Tobacco Companies, Tobacco Dealers,
Agents, Mandiwalas and Suppliers shall submit to the Board returns and furnish
such other information as may be required by the Board from time to time, on
the prescribed forms and within the stipulated period.
10. Interpretation of rules. ‑‑All matters
connected with the interpreta?tion of these rules shall be referred to the
Chairman, Pakistan Tobacco Board, whose decision shall be final.
